subject: [PATCH 18/60] mm/khugepaged: base the recommended min_free_kbytes on common memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the handling of memory fragmentation in the kernel's khugepaged functionality, which is responsible for splitting large pages into smaller ones. The current implementation reserves two pageblocks per populated zone to help THP allocations avoid fragmentation. This patch specifically modifies the set_recommended_min_free_kbytes() function to only count zones on N_MEMORY_COMMON nodes, as these are the ones that use ordinary memory.
